title: Network coordinator worker Batch 2 auth secret journal safety
summary: Closed Batch 2 network coordinator/worker auth, secret redaction, command journal, protocol coercion, done-log metadata, and join blob hardening findings.
reason: The network coordinator/worker audit confirmed weak configured startup tokens, incomplete cluster-log redaction, validation-failure journaling of join blobs, dropped done failure/quarantine log events, loose ClaimResponse coercion, and missing join blob hostile-path caps.
behavior_before: Startup could accept weak configured coordinator tokens; cluster logs redacted only message text; Local API validation failures could journal secret-bearing join_blob requests; done failure/quarantine events passed unsupported log kwargs; ClaimResponse accepted truthy/falsy coercions; join blob helpers lacked semantic size, row, and field caps.
behavior_after: Startup and live token rotation share token-strength validation; every rendered cluster-log field is redacted; validation failures skip request journaling for unjournaled/secret-transfer routes and join_blob keys redact in journal evidence; done failure/quarantine metadata stays in redacted messages compatible with the production log signature; ClaimResponse booleans/integers are strict; join blobs enforce encoded/decoded size, row count, and field length caps before settings save.
rollback_plan: Revert only the listed Batch 2 Python source/test files, regenerated summaries, and this change packet. No media policy, FFmpeg, subtitle/audio, source/scratch/output movement, publish/drain, queue processing, or WebView lifecycle behavior was intentionally changed.
notes:
